mapper.select: SELECT f.festival_id, f.category_id, f.festival_nm, c.category_nm FROM festival f LEFT JOIN category c ON f.category_id = c.category_id ORDER BY f.festival_id
SELECT f.festival_id, f.category_id, f.festival_nm, c.category_nm FROM festival f LEFT JOIN category c ON f.category_id = c.category_id WHERE f.festival_id = #{festivalId}
SELECT f.festival_id, f.category_id, f.festival_nm, c.category_nm FROM festival f LEFT JOIN category c ON f.category_id = c.category_id WHERE f.category_id = #{categoryId} ORDER BY f.festival_nm

SELECT f.festival_id, f.category_id, f.festival_nm, c.category_nm FROM festival f LEFT JOIN category c ON f.category_id = c.category_id WHERE f.festival_nm LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY f.festival_nm
